definitions.growthDenominator: Every initial actor ID; no-goal/missing-goal actors remain in the conservative whole-input denominator. goalParticipants is reported separately.
definitions.growthComplete: Initial target IDs and slot count must remain identical; production progress reports openingComplete and all target slots completed. The timestamp is the first published observed frame, not the exact craft-event instant.
definitions.firstNightComplete: Observed initial-target completion strictly before day-1 morning plus night deadline (250 seconds for this unchanged rules input).
definitions.wornHero: Ever observed five actual equipped tier>=4 items: current non-deleted equipment catalogue entries, matching slot, valid positive integer inventory quantity, compatible weapon. Target ownership alone is not five equipped items.
definitions.fullTeamRegroup: Start only when >=2 current living members of the whole team are separated in one combat space and have a valid version-1 joining/waiting/arrived signal. Freeze those member IDs for the attempt; all must remain living, same team/space and contact one zone for completion.
definitions.regroupDenominator: All started attempts, including member death, roster/space changes, cleared intent and unfinished attempts; partial pair contact is not full-team success. Recovery/threat/action holds do not create new attempts; stale revival intent cannot restart an old attempt.
definitions.movement: Nonzero consecutive same-actor A-B-A move pairs. Break on mismatching from, death, revive or combat-space lifecycle events. These are observations, not automatically bugs.
definitions.teamRetreat: Legacy consecutive explicit team-outnumbered move reversal counts are not bounded in elapsed time and do not by themselves prove an illegal immediate re-entry. The lifecycle-aware move pairs also contain 5 explicit reason pairs here.
definitions.ending: Production ending.cause is the last recorded death cause, not a sole causal explanation of the winner.
definitions.initialAxes: Three varied initial-roster-build seeds may change teams, weapons and route targets together. Catalogue/map/rules and actor IDs stay unchanged; this is not a positions-only or single-strategy causal comparison.
definitions.evidenceBoundary: Past output logs are retained report evidence only; measurement unit checks generate fresh controlled inputs and do not use historic result files as expected fixtures.
